title: The geometric rank-zero orientation in graph-normalized unit coordinates
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a positive integer annihilating A, and f:X→Y a separated quasi-compact compactifiable etale morphism between Noetherian schemes. Assume N is invertible in the global sections of X. Let d be a natural number with a supplied equality hd:d=0. Supply Geometry d for the diagonal section of the first projection, and an isomorphism alpha:omega_f≅line A N X d satisfying OrientationNormalized, with the actual Rees specialization and bundle-section adjoint [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps, def-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-data]. For every graph/homotopy-normalized compact-support comparison family C [def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates], alpha followed by zeroLineIso at d and hd equals finiteSmoothOmegaCoordinates A C f. This assertion concerns the orientation at the coefficient unit only; it contains no tensor mate at a variable complex.

proof.text: Extract the normalized Rees comparison, the cone/bundle square, and the map equality from OrientationNormalized. Install the supplied Geometry so its compactification and conormal-rank proofs are used consistently.
Apply the rank-zero etale section specialization/integration formula to the section Delta of p₁, and apply the diagonal coordinate identity to f.

The bundle-section adjunct is invertible by bundleAdjoint_isIso, and the normal-section mate is invertible by normalSectionMap_isIso. Substitute the two factor equations into the extracted orientation equation and cancel their composite. This proves alpha.hom = omegaCoordinates.hom followed by zeroLineIso.inv. Postcompose with zeroLineIso.hom and use Iso.ext to get the unchanged equality of isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteSmoothZeroOrientationCoordinates
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [Etale f]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 0)
    (G : FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d
      (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    (alpha : dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅ line A N hA X d)
    (hAlpha : OrientationNormalized A N hN hA f d G hX alpha)
    (C : FiniteSmoothCompactSupportComparisons A)
    (hC : FiniteSmoothComparisonNormalized A C) :
    alpha ≪≫ zeroLineIso A N hA X d hd = finiteSmoothOmegaCoordinates A C f
